settings.heading: How can I make a return?
settings.row_content: In the case of a return, please contact our support team. We will review your request and, in the case of a complaint, replace the package.

settings.heading: What should I do if I received the wrong products?
settings.row_content: Please contact our support team with your order number. Unfortunately, it can happen that there is a mix-up with an order. This may mean you receive incorrect products.

settings.heading: How much is the shipping cost?
settings.row_content:
Standard Shipping (within Mainland UK):

  • Orders under 2kg: £3.95 (delivered by Royal Mail)
  • Orders over 2kg: £5.95 (delivered by Parcelforce)
  • Orders over £70: Free delivery

Next Day Shipping (within Mainland UK):
All orders placed before 13:00 Monday to Friday will be dispatched on the same day for delivery on the next working day. This excludes orders placed on the weekend.

  • Orders < 2kg - £5.95
  • Orders > 2kg - £7.95

Next Day Shipping is excluded from out free shipping on orders over £70

Shipping to Northern Ireland:

Flat rate: £16.95 due to the Northern Ireland Protocol.

settings.heading: Can I track my shipment?
settings.row_content:
You will receive a shipping confirmation email as soon as your package is shipped. This email will include a tracking number, allowing you to track the delivery through the courier's website.

The tracking information on Parcelforce and Royal Mail tracking pages usually takes approximately 24 hours to update after you receive the shipping confirmation email

settings.heading: Is it possible to pre-order?
settings.row_content: Unfortunately, pre-orders are not yet possible. If you subscribe to the newsletter, you will always be informed about our latest offers.

settings.heading: How long does delivery take?
settings.row_content:
Orders are usually delivered within 1 - 3 business days.
Please note that delivery times may vary, especially on and around public holidays, due to potential disruption in shipping services.

settings.heading: Allergens, vegan or gluten intolerant?
settings.row_content:
All of our products, unless stated otherwise, are suitable for vegans and people with a gluten intolerance, in the process of distillation, all gluten molecules are filtered out. All of our Moonshines, unless indicated otherwise, are allergen free in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 and amendments. If you require any further information on allergens, please use the contact form below.

*Our cream varieties are not vegan*

settings.heading: What is the shelf life of the liqueur?
settings.row_content:
Our liqueur can be kept for at least 3-5 years when stored sealed in a cool, dry location. The cream varieties have a minimum shelf life of one year.

What should I do if the bottle has already been opened?
Once opened, we recommend keeping it closed (with the original lid) and in a cool place.

settings.heading: Do you accept returns for the empty jars?
settings.row_content: Unfortunately, we do not currently offer returns for empty jars. Additionally, for hygienic reasons, it is not possible to refill the jars.

settings.heading: How should I dispose of my jars if I cannot reuse them?
settings.row_content: If you cannot find another use for the jars, please dispose of them properly in a glass recycling container.

settings.heading: How long does delivery take?
settings.row_content:
Orders are usually delivered within 1 - 3 business days.
Please note that delivery times may vary, especially on and around public holidays, due to potential disruption in shipping services.

settings.heading: Which payment methods do you accept?
settings.row_content: We accept Mastercard, Maestro, Amex, Visa, PayPal as well as Klarna, Shop Pay, Google Pay and Apple Pay. Purchase on account is possible via Klarna.

settings.heading: What do I have to keep in mind with the promotions?
settings.row_content:
The promotions are only available for a certain period of time and cannot be combined with discount codes or other promotions.

You will be informed of all the important details of our promotions in advance so that you don't miss them. You can sign up to our newsletter to ensure you stay in the loop here.

settings.heading: Are your vouchers reusable?
settings.row_content:
No, however you can use a voucher as part of the value for your order, and spend the remaining balance at a later time.
If you encounter any issues with your code, feel free to contact our support team.

settings.heading: How do I redeem my voucher?
settings.row_content:
You can redeem our vouchers during checkout.
If you encounter any issues with your code, feel free to contact our support team.

settings.heading: How do I sign up for the newsletter?
settings.row_content: If you are interested in staying up to date, you can easily subscribe to our newsletter. You will also receive a 10% discount code for signing up, which you can redeem when you place your order. Don't worry, if you change your mind, you can easily unsubscribe from the newsletter.

settings.heading: How can I unsubscribe from the newsletter?
settings.row_content: You can unsubscribe at any time by clicking on the "Unsubscribe" link at the bottom of the newsletter.

settings.heading: What does it mean to be a gang member?
settings.row_content:
As an O'Donnell Gang member you enjoy numerous benefits!
You'll have access to exclusive products, be the first to hear all the latest news and collect Proof, to secure free products afterwards.

settings.heading: What are proof points?
settings.row_content:
Proof is our Gang currency. This means that you collect Proof points with every purchase, which you can redeem in the store for special, Gang exclusive products.
1 Proof is equivalent to £1 worth of goods, and you collect Proof with every order. The points will be credited to you seven days after your purchase.

settings.heading: How can I collect Proof points?
settings.row_content:
You can collect Proof points in various ways:

  • With every purchase in the store
  • By following our social media channels
  • By subscribing to our newsletter
  • By recommending O'Donnell to your friends
  • By leaving a review in the online store.

We will credit you 2 proofs for each review. You can receive proof for a maximum of five reviews per day. Please note that it may take a few hours for the Proof points to be credited for your reviews.
